meta.title: Recognise a stock material vs a cost-centre material
gaps: Deterministically assert that the stock material has an empty Account Assignment Category while the cost-centre material shows K with a cost centre.
Verify that both materials generate a goods sheet.
Verify that the resulting purchase order carries the Account Assignment Category.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Deterministically assert that the stock material has an empty Account Assignment Category while the cost-centre material shows K with a cost centre.; Verify that both materials generate a goods sheet.; Verify that the resulting purchase order carries the Account Assignment Category.

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the buyer.
Ensure the comparison is performed on open requisitions, where sourcing is available.

args.goal: show the Account Assignment Category column in the Open Purchase Requisitions list, compare an available stock material line with an available cost-centre material line, and record whether the stock category is empty and the cost-centre category is K with a cost centre

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated assertion for PR account-assignment columns, so inspect and compare the two required material lines on screen.
Assert that the required PR-list column is visible after the on-screen inspection.
